title: cli.command.laboratories.detach.Response
description:
Confirmation — detach succeeded; echoes the laboratory id that was
detached.

laboratory_id.description: The laboratory id that was detached from the target.

machine.description:
The machine id of the laboratory host the attachment row
records (the provided pair, or the auto-filled local one).

machine_state.description: The state the attachment row records, paired with `machine`.
